bugs: The stock column has no upper bound (app/Imports/ProductRowParser.php:30). The probe accepted 99999999999 for an unsignedInteger column. SQLite stores it, but MySQL/Postgres would throw inside the batched upsert, so the whole job fails instead of skipping one row.

Row error reasons include the raw cell value (ProductRowParser.php:29-30). A 300-char price gave a reason longer than the varchar(255) `reason` column (probe confirmed). Strict MySQL/Postgres would reject the insert and fail the import.
The summary mail is sent synchronously after the import is marked Completed (ProcessImport.php:100). If the mailer throws, the retry sees Completed, returns early, and the email is never sent.
A missing or invalid header is only caught in the background job, which marks the import failed. It is not rejected with a 422 at upload.
antipatterns: app/Jobs/ProcessImport.php:35-38 claims the import with a query-builder update, so the in-memory model drifts from the database (status and started_at go stale)
app/Imports/CsvReader.php + ProductRowParser.php + InvalidCsvHeader.php: three extra classes plus hand-rolled validation via a match on is_numeric/filter_var, where Laravel's Validator would do
tests/Feature/ImportTest.php:232 calls handle() with manually resolved dependencies instead of using dispatch_sync
strengths: Uses a proper API surface: routes/api.php, Sanctum token auth and redirectGuestsTo for api/*. The probe got 202 with a bearer token in production env.
Route-level ->can('view','import') authorization plus a policy using ->is()
File::types()->max() fluent rule; returns 202 Accepted for async work
Streams the CSV with a LazyCollection and processes it in chunks with a batched Product::upsert, so it scales to 5MB files
Counts created vs updated correctly, including duplicate SKUs within a chunk
Resource uses whenLoaded and map->only higher-order proxy
Markdown Mailable with Envelope/Content; queue attributes #[Tries] #[Backoff] #[DeleteWhenMissingModels]
Tests cover the 5MB boundary, BOM and header case, a multi-chunk file, duplicate SKUs, a missing header column, idempotency and email contents

bugs: The /api/imports routes are registered in routes/web.php under session 'auth' middleware (routes/web.php:10-13). The probe with env=production got 419 CSRF token mismatch on POST. A real API client cannot upload. There is no token auth, so only a same-origin session SPA can use the endpoint, and the tests pass only because CSRF is skipped during unit tests.

Every row costs one query or more: updateOrCreate (select + insert/update) or rowErrors()->create (ProcessImport.php:60,127). There is no chunking or batching, so a 5MB file means hundreds of thousands of queries under a 300s timeout.
If a crash happens mid-file, the retry wrongly counts already-imported rows as 'updated' (impl-1 has the same issue).
antipatterns: routes/web.php:10 API endpoints in the web route file with a manual prefix('api'), instead of the api routing (install:api / Sanctum)
app/Http/Controllers/ImportController.php:24 eager-loads rowErrors on a freshly created import, which can have none

app/Jobs/ProcessImport.php:27 duplicates the COLUMNS constant from StoreImportRequest::REQUIRED_COLUMNS, and the BOM/header normalisation is duplicated at StoreImportRequest.php:41 and ProcessImport.php:88
app/Jobs/ProcessImport.php:100 rowData() is recomputed for each row, once in rowProblem and again in upsert
Gate::authorize in the controller, where route ->can() middleware would be terser (acceptable)
strengths: Validates the header at upload in a FormRequest after() hook, so a bad file is rejected with 422 and never queued
Validates each row with Laravel's Validator::make, giving standard messages and bounds (stock max, price max), so values that would overflow columns are caught as row errors
Domain state methods on the model (markProcessing/markCompleted/markFailed)
Queued Notification with Tries/Backoff attributes for the summary email, so mail failures are retried on their own
Thin controller and ImportResource with an explicit errors shape
Idempotent re-run and reset of row errors on retry
Thorough tests: 5MB boundary, non-CSV, missing header, reordered/BOM headers, blank lines, duplicate SKU, retry after a crash, failed() hook, guest/other-user/404

v.rationale: Both suites pass (impl-2: 24 tests, impl-1: 20) and both use similar modern idioms: #[Fillable], casts(), enum status, queue attributes, policy with ->is(). The ranking comes down to what probing found. impl-2 puts POST /api/imports in routes/web.php behind session auth. Outside the test environment the probe got 419 CSRF mismatch, so the main endpoint is unusable for a normal API client. Its per-row updateOrCreate is also heavy for 5MB files. impl-1 sets up real API routing with Sanctum (the probe got 202 with a bearer token), returns 202, uses route ->can() and the File rule builder, and streams the file through a LazyCollection with chunked upserts. impl-1 has its own edge bugs: no upper bound on stock, reasons that echo raw input past 255 chars, a synchronous mail that a retry can lose, and header checks that happen only in the job. Its hand-rolled row validation is less idiomatic than impl-2's Validator::make and FormRequest after() hook. Still, impl-1's bugs only bite on unusual input, while impl-2's breaks the endpoint for API clients, so impl-1 ranks first.
